rationale: The original short thesis required FPS to stay below session VWAP ($25.86) and the 5-minute 9-EMA ($25.87), both of which have now been reclaimed with last price at $25.94. Closing now exits a broken setup before the hard stop is hit, while avoiding a long flip against the heavy -14.42% gap and weak broader market (SPY -0.96%).
